original_finding_content.subject: Podcast description claims $1.25M+ Etsy revenue
original_finding_content.raw_text:
**What:** Podcast host describes themselves as a multi-six-figure Etsy and Shopify seller with $1.25M+ in total Etsy sales, claiming top 0.1% shop ranking and $500K from a single product.
**Verbatim snippet:** "you will learn some of the top techniques and strategies I learned on my way to selling over $1.25M on the Etsy platform. We will cover everything from how I regularly receive over 50,000 visits to my shop per month to how I made over $500,000 from one product in my shop."
**Source:** https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/etsy-seller-success-tips-for-starting-growing-and/id1647518076
**source_type:** video_transcript
**verification_status:** could_not_verify
**Date:** 2025
**Notes:** Text is from Apple Podcasts show-level description, not from a specific episode transcript within the time window. Author: Dylan Jahraus. Revenue claims: $1.25M+ total, $500K from one product, 50K+ monthly visits. Also sells on Shopify. No specific episode verified. Podcast audio not accessible for transcript verification. Degraded to Part 4 because source is show description, not verifiable episode transcript.
